What We Build

Industrial packaging, built to spec

Every crate and pallet leaves our yard sized, treated and labeled for the job it's going to do — whether that's a short haul across the district or a container headed overseas.

PRODUCT / 01

Wooden Pallets

Load-bearing pallets in standard sizes or cut to your dimensions, ready for daily warehouse traffic or a one-way export run.

PRODUCT / 02

Plywood Packing Boxes & Crates

Full plywood crates and packing boxes that keep machinery, glass and fragile equipment intact from our yard to your customer's dock.

PRODUCT / 03

Export Packing

Packaging braced, strapped and labeled the way freight forwarders expect, so your shipment clears customs without a hitch.

PRODUCT / 04

ISPM-15 Fumigation Treated Wood

Heat-treated and fumigated wood, stamped to ISPM-15, so your shipment doesn't get held up at any border.

PRODUCT / 05

Custom Industrial Packaging

Odd-sized load or a one-off crate nobody else wants to touch? We spec it, cut it and deliver it on your timeline.

Our Approach

Packaging that's built for the job, not off the shelf

Every order starts with what's actually being shipped — its weight, its fragility, and where it's headed. That decides the wood, the treatment and the build, not the other way round.

It's why clients who started with a single pallet order fifteen years ago are still calling us for their export crates today.
